title: The Cayley maps identify the unit disk and upper half-plane
statement: Define φ(w)=i(1+w)/(1−w) and ψ(z)=(z−i)/(z+i) for all complex arguments using total complex division. Let D={w∈ℂ : |w|<1} and H={z∈ℂ : Im z>0}. Then φ maps D into H, ψ maps H into D, φ(ψ(z))=z for every z∈H, and ψ(φ(w))=w for every w∈D.
lean_statement: (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < 1 → 0 < (Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w)).im) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ‖(z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)‖ < 1) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Complex.I * (1 + (z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)) / (1 - (z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)) = z) ∧ (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < 1 → (Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) - Complex.I) / (Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) + Complex.I) = w)
